title: STARTTLS: TLS for transit peering (inbound + outbound)
description: Extend transit peering to use TLS when configured. Inbound: wrap accepted peering connections in TLS. Outbound: each [[peers.peer]] entry gains tls=true flag; when set, dial with TLS. Support per-peer ca_cert override for self-signed certs. Blocked on: stoa-74b386c0.
